subject: Invoice creation & delivery - onboarding decision and portal migration window
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: AP Team <ap@novus.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Invoice creation & delivery - onboarding decision and portal migration window

Hi Evan / Novus AP team,

Thanks again for the warm intro call yesterday. To make the first invoice cycle smooth for both teams I want to confirm how you prefer to receive invoices and what evidence you need for VAT/reverse-charge. Two options we support:

1) Email PDF deliveries to ap@novus.com (with invoice PDF + VAT proof attached) — easiest short term, copies to billing contact.
2) Portal/API enrollment — machine-readable XML/ZIP push (SFTP or webhook) and portal UI for download and archiving — best for automated reconciliation.

Questions for you:
- Do you need the invoice to include a purchase order (PO) number on the face, and if yes, is PO required before payment or after?
- For VAT: do you require a VAT certificate on each invoice, or will a single entity-level certificate on file suffice?
- If portal onboarding is acceptable, we can schedule the handoff and a short API test window; otherwise we will deliver PDFs by email and add an AP contact for copies.

Attached: sample invoice PDF (redwood_invoice_sample_Q3.pdf) and our portal onboarding checklist (portal_onboarding_checklist.xlsx).

Proposed next step: quick 20-min AP sync on Wednesday to confirm PO + VAT preference, then we lock schedule for first invoice.

Thanks,

Mateo Alvarez
Customer Success – Billing
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187
From: Evan Salazar <evan.salazar@novus.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@novus.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T13:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice creation & delivery - onboarding decision and portal migration window

Hi Mateo,

Appreciate the clear options. Quick answers:
- PO: We can provide a PO number for the first invoice (PO12345). AP needs the PO on the PDF to route to our payment run. We do not require a PO before service delivery for pilot customers, but AP prefers it on the invoice.
- VAT: Novus operates under reverse charge for US <> EU flows; we need VAT evidence attached to the invoice (entity VAT cert) for the first 3 months while our tax team validates. After that a single certificate on file is fine.
- Portal: We prefer API/portal onboarding long term — monthly reconciliation will be much easier. However, our SFTP team needs a 2-week lead for firewall rules. In the interim please email PDFs to ap@novus.com and cc ap-archive@novus.com.

Would it be possible to have the first PDF invoice on Monday (2026-11-09) with PO12345 and the VAT certificate attached, and then follow up with a portal enrollment kickoff on 2026-11-23? If so we'll route the SFTP firewall request today.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Salazar
AP Manager, Novus Health
evan.salazar@novus.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice creation & delivery - onboarding decision and portal migration window

Kimberly — forwarding Evan's note. Short recommendation from billing ops:

- Send the first invoice by email on 2026-11-09 with PO12345 and include the VAT cert (we already have the cert on file for Novus? see attachment).
- Create a portal enrollment ticket and target API test window the week of 2026-11-23. Set SFTP as the initial transport and offer webhook if they prefer later.
- Adjust the invoice template to add a small "PO reference" field above the line items so AP systems pick it up reliably.

I'll draft the XML sample and the firewall checklist for their SFTP team. Want me to go ahead and schedule the 20-min call with Evan for Monday morning?

Connor O'Brien
Billing Operations
connor_obrien@redwood.com
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Evan Salazar <evan.salazar@novus.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, AP Team <ap@novus.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice creation & delivery - onboarding decision and portal migration window

Thanks Evan — that plan works.

Action items:
- Mateo: send invoice PDF with PO12345 + VAT cert by 2026-11-09 EOD (attachment: redwood_invoice_sample_Q3.pdf). NOTE: due to an internal cut-off we will route this from billing@redwood.com; please confirm that ap@novus.com will accept incoming from billing@redwood.com.
- Connor: create portal enrollment ticket and share SFTP host/IP + firewall checklist with Novus SFTP team; target API test week of 2026-11-23.
- Kimberly: update invoice template to show "PO reference" line above totals and confirm XML tag mapping for PO (we will send sample XML).

Evan — can you confirm ap@novus.com accepts invoices from billing@redwood.com and reply-all once firewall request is submitted? If yes, we are set.

Best,
Mateo

Attachments: redwood_invoice_sample_Q3.pdf (invoice preview, 1 page), portal_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (worksheet)
